packageRules.description: wait 3 days before GitHub Actions version updates, matching what security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm (via config:best-practices) does for npm; digest updates have no release timestamp, so they are not included
handle internal dependencies first (higher priority) and exempt them from minimumReleaseAge requirement

minor.description: A minor bump to an internal dependency should cause a minor bump in this package's version

patch.description: A patch bump to an internal dependency should cause a patch bump in this package's version

packageRules.description: eslint-config-scratch should not cause a new release (also avoids circular dependency)
allow choosing Node upgrades from the full menu
